slots.image_prompt: A vast deep space scene rendered in dark navy and midnight blue tones, with flowing luminous code streams and geometric grid lines weaving through the composition. Glowing sky blue neon light streaks trace abstract pathways across the frame, intersecting with floating translucent hexagonal and rectangular geometric shapes. Distant star-like particles drift softly. The overall mood is futuristic, mysterious, and intellectually expansive. Palette dominated by #1A1A2E deep background with #2196F3 sky blue and #00BCD4 cyan accents. Full-frame cinematic wide composition, no text, no logos.

An abstract symbolic composition representing collective collaboration and shared knowledge. Interconnected glowing nodes of varying sizes form an organic network, with luminous sky blue connection lines flowing between them like rivers of information. Some nodes pulse with bright cyan light, symbolizing active contribution points. The background is a deep neutral dark with subtle gradients. Translucent geometric frames overlay portions of the network, suggesting structure within freedom. Mood is communal, dynamic, and intellectually vibrant. Palette: #1A1A2E background, #2196F3 primary glow, #00BCD4 accent highlights. No text, no letters, no numbers.

An abstract four-quadrant conceptual diagram visualized as a luminous geometric composition. At the exact center, a brilliant sky blue glowing orb radiates four symmetrical beams of light extending toward four corners of the frame. Each beam terminates in a soft luminous sphere of slightly different cyan shade. Thin geometric connector lines form a subtle cross pattern behind the glow. The entire composition floats against a deep navy dark background with faint ambient particles. Balanced, symmetrical, meditative and precise. Palette: #1A1A2E deep background, #2196F3 central glow, #00BCD4 edge accents. No text, no labels, no numbers.

An abstract technological background suitable for a chapter divider. Delicate circuit board traces and geometric line patterns spread across the entire frame in a subtle, non-distracting manner. Faint sky blue gradient bands sweep horizontally across the middle of the composition, creating a sense of division and transition. Tiny hexagonal node points sit at circuit intersections, glowing softly. The upper and lower halves have slightly different textural density, suggesting a boundary. Deep dark navy dominates with precise sky blue linear accents. Minimal, elegant, and ceremonial. Palette: #1A1A2E dominant, #2196F3 accents, #00BCD4 highlights. No text, no words.

An abstract conceptual illustration contrasting opacity and transparency. On the left side, a dense solid dark cube with closed surfaces, faint locked energy contained within, symbolizing enclosure and mystery. On the right side, a crystalline transparent structure composed of overlapping translucent glass-like geometric panels, with sky blue light streaming freely through every gap and edge. A subtle dividing atmosphere separates the two halves, with light particles migrating from right to left. The mood is philosophical and contemplative. Deep navy background, sky blue luminous transparency on the right, dark muted opacity on the left. Palette: #1A1A2E background, #2196F3 glow, #00BCD4 highlights. No text.

An abstract distributed network topology visualization representing collaborative community structure. Multiple glowing nodes of varying brightness and size are scattered across the frame in an organic non-hierarchical arrangement, connected by luminous sky blue threads of varying intensity. Some nodes are brighter and larger, radiating outward connections like hub points, while smaller peripheral nodes cluster loosely around them. The connections form a web-like mesh suggesting decentralized interdependence. Subtle depth layers with foreground and background nodes create spatial richness. Deep navy background with soft ambient glow. Palette: #1A1A2E base, #2196F3 primary node glow, #00BCD4 connection highlights. No text, no labels.

An abstract radial expansion visualization evoking future possibilities and divergent paths. At the geometric center, a brilliant sky blue luminous core radiates outward in four distinct energetic streams, each traveling along a different directional trajectory into the darkness. The streams are composed of flowing light particles and subtle geometric wireframe hints, suggesting branching futures. The periphery fades into deep space with scattered distant particles. The overall feeling is expansive, hopeful, and forward-looking. Symmetrical four-way radiation from a single unified origin. Palette: #1A1A2E deep space background, #2196F3 central core glow, #00BCD4 stream accents. No text, no words, no numbers.

A serene deep starfield background for a presentation closing scene. A vast cosmic expanse in dark navy and midnight blue, dotted with thousands of tiny luminous star particles of varying brightness. Subtle geometric patterns — faint hexagonal grids and thin line fragments — are sparsely scattered like distant constellations, reminiscent of code structure viewed from far away. A soft sky blue nebula glow occupies the lower center area, gently illuminating the scene. The atmosphere is contemplative, peaceful, and conclusive. Palette: #1A1A2E dominant deep space, #2196F3 soft glow, #00BCD4 star highlights. No text, no logos.
